title: Lesson 1: Left-hand home keys

touchTyping.title: What is touch typing?
paragraphs: Touch typing means typing without looking at the keyboard. Each finger has its own keys, so your fingers learn where everything is.
Sit up straight, keep your wrists relaxed, and let your fingers rest on the home row. Always return to the home row after each key.
Go slowly. Accuracy matters more than speed - speed comes by itself with practice.

advice: Rest the fingers of your left hand on the keys A, S, D and F. Your little finger goes on A, then ring finger on S, middle finger on D and index finger on F.
Rest your thumbs lightly on the space bar. Press it with either thumb after every word.
Keep your right hand relaxed beside the keyboard. You will learn its keys in the next lessons.
